beatOutlines.textOutline: Seeing Kesar Paints' RSI cross 75, Raju immediately shorts the stock.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Sharma ji shakes his head and reminds him of the first rule of trading oscillators with trend.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Raju shorted at ₹148, but the stock didn't pause; it accelerated with fierce upward momentum.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Over the next three sessions price hit ₹148 while RSI pegged at 82, wiping out Raju's stop.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Murphy's cardinal law: in strong trends, an overbought oscillator confirms momentum, not an immediate reversal.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: In Murphy's Chapter 10, we uncover the mechanical depth of Momentum, ROC, and RSI.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: We will examine how velocity slows before price turns, and how CCI and RSI detect this shift.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: And finally, Welles Wilder's most reliable standalone setup: RSI Failure Swings and Divergences.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Murphy's fundamental premise: oscillators are secondary filters that operate best strictly in the direction of the trend.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Only when the market is trapped in a non-trending trading range can you trade both oscillator extremes symmetrically.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

scenes.title: Measuring Momentum and Rate of Change
scenes.concept: Measuring Momentum and Rate of Change

beatOutlines.textOutline: Momentum measures the net difference between today's close and N days ago, while ROC calculates the percentage ratio.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Just like a ball thrown upward decelerates before reversing, price momentum flattens before the price peak.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Crossing the ROC 100 level or the Momentum zero-line signals the birth of a fresh directional trend.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

takeaways: Measuring Momentum and Rate of Change

beatOutlines.textOutline: Donald Lambert created the Commodity Channel Index in 1980 to capture cyclical turning points in markets.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: When CCI moves above +100, it confirms an aggressive bullish breakout rather than immediate exhaustion.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: And when it slips back below +100, trend traders book long profits and step to the sidelines.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: In 1978, J. Welles Wilder Jr. introduced the RSI, bounding momentum forever within a neat 0 to 100 scale.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: In bull markets RSI typically oscillates between 40 and 80, whereas in bear markets it stays confined between 20 and 60.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Never treat 70 and 30 as rigid absolutes; the RSI operational zones shift dynamically with the macro trend.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: When price hits a higher high but RSI fails to exceed its previous peak, a bearish divergence forms.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Similarly, when price hits a lower low but RSI carves a higher low, bullish divergence signals smart money accumulation.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Murphy underscores that RSI divergence is the most potent early-warning indicator in all of technical analysis.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: According to Wilder, RSI's most infallible signal is the 'Failure Swing', occurring completely independent of price chart action.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: In a Top Failure Swing, RSI exceeds 70, pulls back, and the next rally fails below 70 before breaking the prior trough.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: The instant RSI slices below the intervening trough, a confirmed sell signal fires regardless of the price chart.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Now your turn. Correctly evaluate this classic RSI technical setup.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Think... carefully connect the price higher high with the RSI swing structure.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Bearish Divergence and a Top Failure Swing! Their simultaneous occurrence signals a high-conviction trend reversal.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Raju acknowledges his mistake and grasps the disciplined way to trade oscillators.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Sharma ji smiles and reinforces the infallible three-pillar oscillator doctrine.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Let us unite the core principles of Chapter 10 Part 1 into a coherent thread.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Shorting above 70 in an uptrend is suicidal; buying oversold dips is the proper strategy.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Zero-line crossings on Momentum and ROC verify the injection of fresh directional energy.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Always respect the RSI range shifts: 40 to 80 in bull markets, and 20 to 60 in bear regimes.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Finally discipline and risk management protect your capital in the market.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

beatOutlines.textOutline: Remember: The oscillator is the speedometer, not the steering wheel; the steering wheel always belongs to price trend.
beatOutlines.speaker: narrator

summarySteps: Oscillators are secondary filters: always trade in the direction of the dominant trend
In uptrends, buy oversold dips; ignore overbought readings as signs of momentum
Momentum and ROC measure speed: deceleration precedes price trend termination
Zero-line / 100-line crossovers confirm macro shifts in directional momentum
CCI +100 signals abnormal trend breakout, while -100 signals severe breakdown
Wilder's RSI normalizes momentum between 0 and 100 using up vs down closes
Bull ranges shift to 40-80, while bear ranges drop down to 20-60
RSI Divergences and Failure Swings offer the highest-conviction reversal signals
bottomTakeaway: Discipline and grounded market understanding are essential for survival.
